rules: Use tabular numerals (tnum) for all financial figures, amounts, and dates so columns align perfectly.
Reserve IBM Plex Mono strictly for IDs, hashes, and wallet addresses. DO NOT use it for regular amounts.
Unbounded is strictly FORBIDDEN in the in-app chrome. Stick to Manrope for headings.

glass.rule: Reserved ONLY for sticky bars (top nav, filter bars) and overlays. Do not spray across normal cards.

rules: Motion should be fast and functional. Avoid bouncy or springy animations.
Use slide-overs for details, sliding in from the right.
Hover states on table rows should be a gentle, quick transition of background color.

AppChrome.nav_rail: Quieter left navigation rail. Dark mode uses canvas color, Light mode uses canvas color. Active states highlighted subtly. No loud backgrounds.
AppChrome.top_bar: Cleaner top bar with sticky glassmorphism. Contains breadcrumbs or simple title, plus user/brand actions.
AppChrome.brand_switcher: Refined company switcher. This is the ONLY place where a merchant's custom accent color should appear (as an avatar/identicon).
AppChrome.theme_density_toggles: Subtle icon buttons in the nav rail or top bar footer.

PageHeader.structure: Title (text-2xl), Context line/subtitle below it (text-sm, ink-secondary), Primary action button right-aligned.

SummaryStrip.structure: Small band of key figures. Horizontal flex or grid of 3-4 tiles.
SummaryStrip.tile_anatomy: Caption/Eyebrow label (text-xs, ink-secondary), KPI Number (text-4xl, tabular nums, ink-primary).
SummaryStrip.styling: No heavy borders, minimal separators between tiles. Airy and confident.

DataTable.structure: Financial-statement style. Pinned header, airy rows.
DataTable.grouping: Group transactions by date (Today, Yesterday, This week). Date header rows should be subdued (ink-secondary, border-b hairline).
DataTable.cell_anatomy: Right-align all numbers. Use tnum. Distinct styling for balance vs amount (e.g., amount is ink-primary, balance is ink-muted).
DataTable.hover: Calm hover: bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.03)] on dark, bg-[rgba(0,0,0,0.02)] on light. Cursor pointer.

SlideOver.structure: Opens from right. Width ~400px. Used for transaction timeline + details/actions.
SlideOver.styling: Surface color background. Left shadow `-8px 0 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)`. Pinned header with close button.

StatusDot.structure: Low-chroma dot + label. Replacing loud solid chips.
StatusDot.styling: Dot: 6px x 6px circle, colored by status. Text: 12px or 13px ink-secondary. Wrapper: flex, items-center, gap-2.

FilterBar.structure: Search input, Status dropdown, Date range picker.
FilterBar.styling: Hairline borders, 8px radius. Background transparent or surface. Quiet and out of the way.

theme_integration: The codebase uses MUI (sx/styled) and a token file at constants/theme.ts. Update the DARK and LIGHT objects in constants/theme.ts with the exact hex values provided in this JSON.
In styles/appTheme.ts (MUI createTheme overrides), map the semantic colors and typography scales to the MUI theme.
Use MUI's sx prop for spacing, applying the hairline borders and soft shadows defined here.
Since lucide-react is the icon library, replace any existing MUI icons or custom SVGs with Lucide icons (e.g., ChevronRight, Search, Activity, Users, Link).
development_guidelines: Do not build a thick, card-heavy UI. The UI should be almost flat, separated by hairline borders and whitespace, similar to Mercury.
Ensure all amounts use tabular numerals (fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums' in sx).
Keep the Dynopay gold (#FFD100) strictly for the primary action button and key active states. Do not use it as a general highlight color.
Ensure the slide-over opens on row click, preserving the main list context.
Implement the 'Needs Attention' area using a subtle warning or info semantic style.

rules: NEVER use generic centered layouts. Content must be left-aligned for data readability.
NEVER use complete transparent background in headers, overlays, or surfaces with content underneath. Always use the specified glass rule or solid surface color.
ALWAYS include data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based) on all interactive elements (buttons, table rows, filter inputs, toggles).
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8) between main structural elements to avoid a cramped spreadsheet look.
Transitions should target specific properties (e.g., background-color, transform) and NOT 'all'.
Data empty states should be graceful: a quiet icon, a subtle message in ink-secondary, and a clear action if applicable.
Skeletons must match the table row height and column widths perfectly.
